title: Evaluating Contrast Localizer for Identifying Causal Units in Social & Mathematical Tasks in Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying units responsible for Theory of Mind (ToM) and mathematical reasoning. While it notes the role of ToM in human moral judgment in its background section, the actual evaluation and benchmarking use cognitive and logical tasks (such as false-belief and arithmetic tests) rather than assessing religious, moral, or ethical values.
